class.name: WebSVGElement
class.brief_description: Base class for the scriptable SVG DOM used by [WebSVG].
class.description: [WebSVGElement] is the base of the scriptable SVG document object model. Each element is a [Node] parented under a [WebSVG] (or a [WebSVGGroup]) and carries the SVG presentation attributes shared by every shape: fill, stroke, opacity and transform. Subclasses such as [WebSVGRect] or [WebSVGCircle] add their own geometry. Elements are serialized to SVG markup in document (child) order when the owning [WebSVG] renders.

method.name: to_svg
method.description: Serializes this element (and, for [WebSVGGroup], its children) to SVG markup.

members.member: The SVG [code]id[/code] attribute emitted for this element.
Fill color. SVG [code]fill[/code]. Defaults to opaque black, matching the SVG default. Ignored when [member fill_none] is [code]true[/code].
If [code]true[/code], the shape is not filled. SVG [code]fill="none"[/code].
Opacity of the fill, from 0 to 1. SVG [code]fill-opacity[/code].
Overall opacity of the element, from 0 to 1. SVG [code]opacity[/code].
Stroke (outline) color. SVG [code]stroke[/code]. Setting this also enables the stroke.
Whether the shape is stroked. Disabled by default, matching the SVG default of no stroke.
Opacity of the stroke, from 0 to 1. SVG [code]stroke-opacity[/code].
Stroke width in pixels. SVG [code]stroke-width[/code]. Defaults to 1, matching the SVG default.

Additional inline CSS declarations (such as [code]stroke-linecap[/code] or [code]stroke-dasharray[/code]) preserved verbatim when this element is serialized. Populated for presentation properties not modeled as typed members, so round-tripping markup keeps them.
